page.overview:
Who is Albertalli?

Albertalli was the mercenary general of the Tilean mercenary regiments that fought alongside General Pavian at Krasicyno during which Albertalli's countrymen held the line for three hours straight, and later led the charge against the Kurgan line at Mazhorod in 2522 IC during the Storm of Chaos where he was slain.

He is described as a dark-haired man with swarthy skin, his moustache waxed in an elaborate upward curl. At the reception at Tzarina Katarin Bokha's court he wore an elaborate silk uniform in blue and silver with puffed sleeves and a white medal sash. He is also passionate about his homeland's wine, claiming it to be superior to Bretonnia's.

Nevertheless, Albertalli was a capable officer who possessed tactical finesse and strong command instincts and got along well with General Kaspar von Velten. As he himself admitted, a lot of luck was involved in the allies' victory against Lenk's Kurgan hordes.

Alongside the armies of Stirland, Talabecland, and the Tzarina Katarin, Albertalli fought at Urszebya against the hordes of Aelfric Cyenwulf in 2522 IC. He and his huge, greataxe-wielding, Tilean sergeants defended the standard of Luccini as they made a brutal counterattack against the Kurgans. He himself wielded a heavy sword alongside his halberdiers, only to replace the thing mid-battle (having left its dull blade inside the enemy's groin) with a fallen halberd of his own. This weapon would also be lost after its tip snapped off inside the belly of a horned, dog-headed beast. Before he could fire with his personal flintlock pistol, the general's head was torn off by the bite of that very same creature.
